Risk: Cross-account merge conflicts on shared schemas
Mitigation: Small PRs; version field in schemas; explicit compatibility tests
Validation step with known-dimension reference; confidence limits

Risk: Large dataset jobs exceed memory/time budget
Mitigation: Streaming ingest; chunked processing; resource budgets per stage

Risk: PostGIS tile queries slow at scale
Mitigation: Spatial indexing; query plan analysis; pagination

Risk: Google Sheet sync not authorized in time
Mitigation: CSV is source of truth; sheet is optional mirror; degrade gracefully

Risk: CI flakiness from external service dependencies
Mitigation: Mock external calls; containerised integration tests; retry logic
